name: The `silo` command
what: Every MVP feature is reached from the `silo` command on your Mac through the same client API the Swift app uses. It prints plain text for a person and one JSON line per item with `--json`, and exports a receipt with its record and file diffs so you or a script can inspect it or hand it to an agent. Scoped `silo` tools inside a computer come after MVP.

suggest.why: It gives both you and your agents scriptable text and JSONL access to Silo from the first feature built.
